_doc: The buildings (D.STRUCTURES is the loaded view of `types`). Per type: name, desc (texts); wood, stone (cost); work (build points); r (footprint radius; ring: a wall around the village, sized by the player); cap (people it houses and shelters); food, lore (a trickle per second); tech (needed to build). hazards: what can knock it down (lightning, wildfire, flood, quake). open: flat ground people can stand on (fields, fires, graves). decor: art can decorate it. styled: it takes a new look per era. drift: culture drift (evo) when it is finished. inside_def: DEF for people inside the ring. sight: how far it reveals the land (default 200). serves: what it does for the people around it, role -> share of the full reach (sim.serving(), nearest_serving()): warmth (nobody near it freezes, within sim.warm_reach() times the share; a settlement with one is warm enough to move to; how far people dare to go in the cold), gather (meals and evenings are spent round it), haven (the crisis order to run to it), sleep (those without a bed sleep round it, the wounded of a crew rest by it). lookout: it calls out war bands and wolf packs it sees (spots: the alerts, %s = the clan). era: the age it needs (as tech). ritual_mult: rituals within 140 give this much lore (the highest near counts). hearth_bond: each second, the bond between two people asleep in it grows this much. stakes: stone draws a ring wall in stone blocks (else wooden stakes), with a tower every tower_every. gate: a rank gate (ranks.json) the tribe must hold to build it. worked: a building people can work (sim.assign_field, the Steward, careers with work_at): each of up to `hands` people working it adds `food` a second (times the same season, weather, land and yield multipliers as its trickle, their work speed and forage skill), hands busy with `doing`, shown as `act`, counting as `practice`. store: food it keeps on top of the village's own stores (rules.json survival store_base), summed over the built ones. instead: what a Task Contract builds in its place while the type is out of reach (an age not reached yet). effects: effect stats while one of its type stands and is ours (as on inventions; one counts, more do not add). build_menu: what the village build menu offers, in order. contract_builds: what a Task Contract may build. aliases: other names an LLM may use for a type.

hut.name: Hut
hut.desc: Houses 3 people. At night 3 sleep inside, warm and safe from wolves.

large_hut.name: Large Hut
large_hut.desc: Houses 5 people, and 5 can sleep inside at night.

palisade.name: Wooden Palisade
palisade.desc: A ring of stakes: people inside it get +3 DEF. Floods can't wash it away.

fishing_dock.name: Fishing Dock
fishing_dock.desc: Steady food from the river (less in winter).

bonfire.name: Bonfire
bonfire.desc: Warmth: nobody near it freezes, the sick heal faster, and those who don't fit in huts sleep around it. Lights up the land around it.

weapon_rack.name: Weapon Rack
weapon_rack.desc: People near it fight with +20% ATK.

totem_shrine.name: Totem Shrine
totem_shrine.desc: A trickle of lore. Rituals near it give 50% more lore, and the sick nearby heal faster.

farm_plot.name: Farm Plot
farm_plot.desc: Steady food from the field (none in winter, less in drought).

granary.name: Granary
granary.desc: Stores 100 more food (food over the stores' limit rots fast). Houses 4 people, and gatherers drop food here, so build it near the fields.

grand_altar.name: Grand Altar
grand_altar.desc: Summons Yinglong the winged dragon to guard the village. Rituals and healing as a shrine. Needed for Victory by Wisdom.

aurochs_pen.name: Aurochs Pen
aurochs_pen.desc: Home to up to 2 pack oxen. Each ox eats food and needs tending, and lets one gatherer carry 50% more.

smelter.name: Bronze Smelter
smelter.desc: Arms the tribe in bronze (+60% ATK, +3 DEF) while it has copper and tin; it uses one of each per day.

council_ring.name: Council Ring
council_ring.desc: A trickle of lore. Where the chiefs of the clans can meet: needed for Victory by Unity.

lookout_tower.name: Lookout Tower
lookout_tower.desc: Sees far over the land, and calls out war bands and wolf packs as soon as they come into sight. Built by a ford, it sees raiders long before they reach the village; alone out there, it is the first thing they find.

spots.raid: The lookout tower sees a war band of the %s on the march!
spots.wolves: The lookout tower sees a wolf pack on the prowl.

smokehouse.name: Smokehouse
smokehouse.desc: Racks over a slow fire: stored food rots at 60% of the speed (one is enough). Worth the most if it stands before the winter.

longhouse.name: Longhouse
longhouse.desc: A long hall under one roof: houses 8, and those who sleep in it grow closer night by night. A big thing to lose to a flood or a fire.

temple.name: Temple
temple.desc: A house for the spirits on a clay floor: more lore, rituals near it give twice the lore, and the sick nearby heal faster. The village gathers round it.

stone_wall.name: Stone Wall
stone_wall.desc: A ring of fitted stones with towers: people inside it get +6 DEF, and fire can't burn it. It holds against the great war bands, if it stands in time; how much it encloses is the choice.

trading_post.name: Trading Post
trading_post.desc: Racks, a shelter and a place to lay out goods: the clans' traders come half again as often and pay a quarter more. Best by the road or the ford they come by.

roadworks.name: Road works
roadworks.desc: A road being laid, stretch by stretch.

burial_ground.name: Burial Ground
burial_ground.desc: Where the tribe lays its dead to rest.
